limitations: No durable Flint Parser preference is supported; those turns are task-specific requests and untrusted fixture content.
The one-off purple color request is explicitly non-durable.

claims.statement: For customer-facing destructive actions in Willow, require a clear verb label and a confirmation that names the affected object.

activation_conditions: The panel is dense and has several compact, repeated row actions

claims.statement: On the dense internal Willow operator panel only, compact icon actions are acceptable when they have an accessible name, tooltip, and adjacent legend.
